New beam path has no LineRenderer/TrailRenderer/ParticleSystem/new Mesh/List<Vector3>.
Hot DTOs use public fields only.
Beam vertex is 32B; trigonometry LUT entries are 8B.
`MockLaserFireSignal` and `PlasmaBeamMockLaserFireJob` isolate ToolKinematics dependency.
`PlasmaBeamTubeMeshingJob` builds tube triangle vertices in Burst.
`noise.snoise` offsets radius with deterministic SectorHash/Frame seed and `math.step` quality gate.
UV.y is generated 0..1 and shader scrolls energy flow from `_H8PlasmaFrameTime`, not Unity `_Time`.
Heat and energy continuously scale tube radius.
Final ring radius is multiplied by 1.5 and color is forced white.
Length segments stay exactly 2 below q=0.3, then lerp 2..20; radial segments lerp 3..8 from `GlobalQualityWeight`.
Vault vertices are uploaded to `GraphicsBuffer` and drawn with `DrawProceduralIndirect`.
Double AUP is subtracted before float trigonometry.
Biome extinction tints packed color toward muddy noir scattering.
Noise amplitude and seed produce `SignalBus<AcousticEchoTap>` packets.
Overwritten vault buffers use `NativeArrayOptions.UninitializedMemory`.
300-frame telemetry ring and `Dump_LASER_SURGEON.bin` fault path exist.
`Plasma Beam Tuner` edits radius, frequency, amplitude, and radial override.
`beam_visuals.csv` parser reads bytes into vault scratch and hashes keys.
Editor hook draws raw `BeamVertexDTO` triangle wireframe in Scene View.

STRUCT_LAYOUT_VERIFICATION.AtomicCounters: No concurrent atomic counters were introduced; false-sharing counter padding is not applicable.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: Below `GlobalQualityWeight` 0.3, `math.step(0.30, q)` forces the length-density curve to 0, so each beam emits exactly 2 length segments and the expensive `noise.snoise` branch is bypassed. Radial density still follows a smooth 3..8 curve and remains 3 at q=0.1. At 1.0, the job emits 20 length segments, 8 radial segments, and crackle noise per vertex. Shader intensity and procedural flicker follow the same continuous weight.

ZERO_GC_HOT_PATH.VisualSyncAllocation: `VisualSyncTick` calls `EnsureGraphicsResources(false)`; GPU buffers, shader lookup, and material allocation are boot-only.
ZERO_GC_HOT_PATH.ShaderTime: Shader scroll/flicker consumes `_H8PlasmaFrameTime`, bound from dispatcher frame * fixed tick/fallback 1/60.
ZERO_GC_HOT_PATH.EditorFacadeFence: Editor tuning and SceneView mesh snapshot APIs refuse vault access while `_simulationScheduled` is true; pending edits are staged and applied at the pre-simulation boundary.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.NoAlias: Burst jobs annotate NativeArray fields with `[NoAlias]`; vertex writes use `NativeDisableParallelForRestriction` for disjoint beam chunks.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.JobGraph: dispatcher dependsOn -> PlasmaBeamMockLaserFireJob -> PlasmaBeamTubeMeshingJob -> PlasmaBeamArgsTelemetryJob -> returned JobHandle
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.MainThreadBlocking: Runtime does not call `JobHandle.Complete`; dispatcher owns the completion barrier before PostSimulation.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.Devirtualization: Domain-local abstract/virtual phase adapter base was removed; sealed adapters implement the dispatcher contract directly.

SELF_AUDIT.COMPILE_GUARD: No direct `using Hecton8.Tools`, `Hecton8.World`, `Hecton8.Audio`, or other sibling runtime imports exist in the VFX runtime. `Hecton8.VFX.PlasmaBeam.Runtime.asmdef` references Core, Core.Contracts, Core.Memory, and Unity packages only; `Hecton8.VFX.PlasmaBeam.Editor.asmdef` references the PlasmaBeam runtime plus Unity Collections/Mathematics. No sibling runtime assembly is referenced.

COMPILE_WALL_POLISH.AsmdefIsolation: Runtime and editor PlasmaBeam assemblies are isolated from the parent compile surface.
COMPILE_WALL_POLISH.VaultHandleCache: `EnsureVaultState` reacquires handles only until defaults are initialized; steady dispatcher phases rely on generation-checked `VaultBufferHandle.Resolve`.
